items.t: Angi Appoints Alex Tolston as Chief Legal Officer
items.sum: DENVER, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Angi (NASDAQ: ANGI), a leading digital home services marketplace, today announced the appointment of Alex Tolston as chief legal officer, succeeding Shannon Shaw, effective immediately. items.t: UBS Maintains Neutral on Angi, Raises Price Target to $9
items.sum: UBS analyst Stephen Ju maintains Angi (NASDAQ:ANGI) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $5 to $9.
